data.title: 毛利兰 · 年末抽奖的意外惊喜
data.description: 年末商店街抽奖摊前，小兰穿砖红牛角扣大衣，手还停在转轮把手旁，金色小球已经滚入托盘。她先惊讶地睁大眼，再不好意思地举起另一只手笑起来，围巾和灯串映出暖暖的节日气氛。
data.action: 停住抽奖转轮，看见金球后惊讶又不好意思地笑。
data.promptProse: At the year-end shopping-street raffle, Ran Mouri keeps one hand near the turning wheel as a gold ball rolls into the tray. She widens her eyes, then raises the other hand with an embarrassed happy laugh above her brick-red duffle coat. The medium portrait includes the raffle counter and light strings behind. Warm festive bulbs catch the gold ball and coat toggles, with small bright reflections inside the metal tray.
